info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Capital Markets Trading Update API
info.description: This API facilitates updates to capital markets trading specifications within the wholesale banking sector. It allows financial institutions to modify trading parameters efficiently, ensuring alignment with current market conditions and regulatory requirements. Typical users include trading analysts and risk management teams who require real-time updates to trading activities. The operation supports various financial instruments and helps maintain accurate trading operations.
